description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, which displays detailed information about a content item in a TV application. It sets up the UI, populates content details, manages focus for TV navigation, and loads resources such as background images and icons. It also provides a static method to create intents for starting this activity with a given content item.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android AppCompatActivity that displays detailed information about specific content, including title, genre, description, background image, and action buttons tailored for TV navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to initialize views, populate content, setup date/time, focus handling, and action buttons.

methods.name: initializeViews
methods.description: Initializes all UI components by finding views by ID and setting up lists for action buttons.

methods.name: populateContent
methods.description: Populates the UI with data from a ContentItem object.

methods.name: populateSampleContent
methods.description: Populates the UI with hardcoded sample content (designed to match a specific image).

methods.name: loadBackgroundFromAssets
methods.description: Loads a background image from the assets folder, falling back to a default resource if loading fails.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets current system time and date in the UI.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Configures action buttons with icons and labels.

methods.name: setupFocusHandling
methods.description: Configures focus change animations for action buttons and sets initial focus.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to start ContentInfoActivity with a specified ContentItem.
